title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 6, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $12,500.00 to
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 6, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $12,500.00 to
  support Office of Operations, Community Engagement Group, Police Academy Magnet Schools
  Program (PAMS), as set forth.  [BPC #26-356]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to accept a $12,500 donation to support the Police Academy Magnet Schools Program (PAMS) in the Office of Operations.
